description: `prose credits topup` keeps the typed verb: `prose cli wallet topup`, whose help shows the amount it needs.

problem.action: Use `cli wallet topup`, then add --amount-cents N; `prose --output json cli wallet topup --help` shows the options of `cli wallet topup`.

details.reason: `credits topup` is not a command; did you mean `prose --output json cli wallet topup`? Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
